# Dian Education

> Dian Education helps Nigerian students prepare for JAMB (UTME) with a clear study plan, with WAEC, NECO and GCE coming next. This site offers a free ebook, "250+ in JAMB, A1 in WAEC" by Joshua John.

## The book

- Title: 250+ in JAMB, A1 in WAEC: A Complete, Practical Study System for Nigerian Students
- Author: Joshua John, founder of Dian Education
- Format: PDF ebook, 13 short chapters, includes a personal study plan template
- Price: free (normally ₦5,000). Readers enter a first name and email to download it.
- For: students writing JAMB or WAEC for the first time or again, and parents helping a child prepare
- Get it: https://dianeducation.com/

## What it teaches

- How JAMB and WAEC work: JAMB rewards speed and recycles questions, WAEC rewards understanding, and both repeat topics
- Using the official JAMB syllabus as a map of what to read and what to ignore
- A 5-step study system: pick one topic, understand it, practise recent questions, review mistakes, track your score
- Using past questions properly: focus on the last 10 years and don't memorise answers
- Studying by energy: hard subjects when fresh, easier ones when tired
- Using AI tools and YouTube well for study
- A JAMB strategy of pushing your one or two strongest subjects to 80 or 90 to lift the total score

## What it does not claim

The book does not promise a score and is not a shortcut or "expo". It is a study system that works only if the student applies it consistently.
